scriptLines: charge_type = iif(     isNull(charge_type) || trim(charge_type) == '',     'Unknown',     iif(         upper(trim(charge_type)) == 'SURGERY',         'Surgery',         iif(             upper(trim(charge_type)) == 'MEDICATION',             'Medication',             iif(                 upper(trim(charge_type)) == 'IMAGING',                 'Imaging',                 iif(                     upper(trim(charge_type)) == 'ROOM',                     'Room',                     iif(                         upper(trim(charge_type)) == 'CONSULTATION',                         'Consultation',                         iif(                             upper(trim(charge_type)) == 'LAB TEST',                             'Lab Test',                             trim(charge_type)                         )                     )                 )             )         )     ) ),

payment_status = iif(     isNull(payment_status) || trim(payment_status) == '',     'Unknown',     iif(         upper(trim(payment_status)) == 'PAID',         'Paid',         iif(             upper(trim(payment_status)) == 'UNPAID',             'Unpaid',             iif(                 upper(trim(payment_status)) == 'PENDING',                 'Pending',                 iif(                     upper(trim(payment_status)) == 'OVERDUE',                     'Overdue',                     'Unknown'                 )             )         )     ) ),

payment_date = iif(     isNull(payment_date) || trim(payment_date) == '',     toDate(null()),     iif(         regexMatch(             trim(payment_date),             '^[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}$'         ),         toDate(             concat(                 '20',                 right(trim(payment_date), 2),                 '-',                 left(trim(payment_date), 2),                 '-',                 substring(trim(payment_date), 4, 2)             ),             'yyyy-MM-dd'         ),         coalesce(             toDate(trim(payment_date), 'yyyy-MM-dd'),             toDate(trim(payment_date), 'MM/dd/yyyy'),             toDate(trim(payment_date), 'dd-MMM-yyyy', 'en-US'),             toDate(trim(payment_date), 'MMMM dd, yyyy', 'en-US'),             toDate(trim(payment_date), 'MM-dd-yyyy')         )     ) )) ~> derivedColumn1
